$comment: Lifecycle register for every direct dependency and toolchain component in the full SBOM (npm run sbom:full). Checked by npm run check:eol; policy in knowledge/operations/dependency-lifecycle.md; plan in docs/eol-plan.md. Keys are <ecosystem>:<name>@<cycle>. eol = the date upstream (or, where marked, this project's policy) stops supporting the cycle; null = rolling release with no fixed date (only the newest line is supported, so stay current).

generic:nodejs@24.support: Active LTS; maintenance LTS from 2026-10-20 (nodejs/Release schedule.json).

generic:nodejs@22.support: Maintenance LTS. Still used by the release workflows only.

plan.action: Move manual-release.yml, release.yml and release-docs.yml to node-version 24 (release-workflow change: human approval required).

generic:debian@trixie.support: Debian 13, base of the Docker toolchain image. Estimated end of regular security support (one year after Debian 14); Debian LTS continues to 2030-06-30.

generic:rust@1.98.support: Upstream supports only the newest stable (6-week cadence). Project policy: never more than four releases behind stable; 1.102 is due 2027-02-04.

plan.action: Bump rust-toolchain.toml, the Dockerfile and the session hook to the current stable at the next quarterly review; rebuild the WASM payload (npm run build:wasm).

generic:rustup@1.support: Rolling; only the Docker image's installer is pinned.

generic:wasm-pack@0.15.support: Rolling. The rustwasm organization was archived in 2025; wasm-pack continues outside it with a small maintainer base.

plan.action: Evaluate replacing wasm-pack with cargo build + wasm-bindgen-cli directly (one fewer pinned binary); decide in an Issue.

generic:wasm-bindgen-cli@0.2.support: Rolling; must equal the wasm-bindgen crate version. Maintained at github.com/wasm-bindgen/wasm-bindgen.

cargo:wasm-bindgen@0.2.support: Rolling; pinned exactly (=) to match wasm-bindgen-cli.

cargo:ruzstd@0.9.support: Rolling; Zstandard codec for .rsf. The frozen .rsf fixtures pin its encoder output.

cargo:lz4_flex@0.14.support: Rolling; LZ4 Frame codec (currently unused but linked; see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

npm:sql.js@1.support: Runtime dependency; infrequent releases. 1.14.2 embeds SQLite 3.49.1 (2025-02), so SQLite fixes reach the app only through sql.js releases.

plan.action: Check at each quarterly review whether sql.js has shipped a newer SQLite; if SQLite advisories affect in-memory use and sql.js lags, open an Issue on building the SQLite WASM ourselves.

npm:vite@8.support: Current major. Vite supports the current minor, plus security fixes for the previous two majors' latest minors.

npm:vitest@5.support: Current major; only the newest major receives fixes (Vitest 3 never received the GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 fix).

npm:typescript@6.support: 6.0 is the last JavaScript-based TypeScript line; 7.x (native compiler) is current. Held on 6 because typescript-eslint 8 supports <6.1.

plan.action: Move to TypeScript 7 once typescript-eslint publishes support for it.

npm:eslint@10.support: Current major; ESLint maintains the previous major for six months after a new one.

npm:@eslint/js@10.support: Released with ESLint; keep on the same major.

npm:jsdom@30.support: Rolling; only the newest major is maintained.

npm:playwright@1.support: Rolling minors; each release pins its browser builds, so stay on the newest minor.

npm:@tailwindcss/vite@4.support: Released with tailwindcss; keep on the same version.
